why: PjBL is a broad instructional approach and fidelity specification, not a general explanatory learning theory or a specific adoptable programme.

P(J) is a narrower machine-learned moment-of-learning variant built from Bayesian Knowledge Tracing rather than a general learning theory, so it belongs as a variant or application on the Bayesian Knowledge Tracing page.

This is an education-specific learning-analytics method that uses tutoring-system transaction features and Bayesian Knowledge Tracing labels to model the probability of learning at a practice opportunity, rather than an instructional element.
name: Machine-learned moment-of-learning prediction from tutoring-system transaction logs
